title: Community Garden Neighbors
description: Four neighbors of diverse ages and backgrounds who share a community garden in Austin, Texas. Connected through gardening partnerships, a book club, church, and local volunteering.

people.name: Ruth Okonkwo
people.role: Retired school librarian, community garden co-founder
people.profile: Nigerian-American, moved to Austin in 1985. Widowed, two adult children. Master gardener who grows heirloom tomatoes and mentors younger gardeners.

observations.text: Ruth Okonkwo co-founded the Eastside Community Garden on Cesar Chavez Street in 2018 with a $5,000 grant from the Austin Parks Foundation.
Ruth Okonkwo retired from Zavala Elementary School after 32 years as the school librarian.
Ruth Okonkwo was born in Lagos, Nigeria, and moved to Austin in 1985 to attend the University of Texas.
Ruth Okonkwo and Sam Delgado share a 20-by-40-foot raised bed at the community garden where they grow heirloom tomatoes.
Ruth Okonkwo and Jenny Liu attend the First United Methodist Church on East 12th Street every Sunday.
Ruth Okonkwo grows 14 varieties of heirloom tomatoes, including Cherokee Purple and Brandywine.
Ruth Okonkwo's late husband, Emeka, was a civil engineering professor at UT Austin who passed away in 2019.
Ruth Okonkwo's daughter Adaeze is an immigration lawyer in Houston.
Ruth Okonkwo's son Chidi is a software engineer at Dell in Round Rock.
Ruth Okonkwo won first place at the Travis County Fair for her Cherokee Purple tomatoes in September 2023.
Ruth Okonkwo hosts the Eastside Book Club at her house on the first Thursday of every month.
Ruth Okonkwo lives in a yellow Craftsman bungalow on East 7th Street that she and Emeka bought in 1990 for $67,000.
Ruth Okonkwo volunteers at the Austin Public Library's literacy program every Wednesday afternoon.
Ruth Okonkwo makes a Nigerian pepper soup every Saturday that she shares with her garden neighbors.
Ruth Okonkwo taught herself beekeeping in 2021 and maintains two hives at the community garden.
Ruth Okonkwo drives a white 2019 Toyota RAV4.
Ruth Okonkwo's favorite book is 'Things Fall Apart' by Chinua Achebe.
Ruth Okonkwo speaks English, Igbo, and Yoruba fluently.
Ruth Okonkwo donated 200 pounds of produce from the community garden to the Capital Area Food Bank in 2023.
Ruth Okonkwo is writing a memoir about growing up in Lagos during the 1970s oil boom.

people.name: Sam Delgado
people.role: High school math teacher and soccer coach
people.profile: Mexican-American, born and raised in Austin. First-generation college graduate. Coaches the girls' soccer team at Travis High School.

observations.text: Sam Delgado teaches AP Calculus and Algebra II at Travis Early College High School.
Sam Delgado grew up in the Montopolis neighborhood of East Austin.
Sam Delgado graduated from UT Austin with a B.S. in Mathematics in 2018, the first in his family to earn a college degree.
Sam Delgado and Ruth Okonkwo share a 20-by-40-foot raised bed at the community garden where they grow heirloom tomatoes.
Sam Delgado and Hana Petrov meet every Sunday morning at Bennu Coffee on East 11th Street to plan garden activities for the week.
Sam Delgado coaches the girls' varsity soccer team at Travis High, leading them to the district semifinals in 2024.
Sam Delgado rents a duplex on East 5th Street, two blocks from the community garden.
Sam Delgado was named Travis High School's Teacher of the Year in May 2024.
Sam Delgado's mother, Elena, works as a medical assistant at CommUnityCare Health Center on East Cesar Chavez.
Sam Delgado plays guitar in a Tejano band called Los Relámpagos that performs at Sahara Lounge on East 6th Street.
Sam Delgado runs a free weekend tutoring program at the Terrazas Branch Library for neighborhood kids.
Sam Delgado built a drip irrigation system for the community garden using recycled materials that cost only $120.
Sam Delgado's favorite dish to cook is birria tacos using his grandmother Lupe's recipe.
Sam Delgado drives a red 2016 Honda Civic with 97,000 miles on it.
Sam Delgado speaks English and Spanish fluently.
Sam Delgado completed a master's degree in Education from Texas State University in December 2023.
Sam Delgado has an older sister named Rosa who is a nurse at Seton Medical Center.
Sam Delgado grows Carolina Reaper and habanero peppers in his personal garden plot at the community garden.
Sam Delgado organized a community garden potluck in June 2024 that drew 45 neighbors.
Sam Delgado adopted a beagle mix named Gol from Austin Pets Alive! in January 2024.

people.name: Jenny Liu
people.role: Acupuncturist and herbalist, community garden plot owner
people.profile: Chinese-American, born in Houston. Owns a holistic wellness clinic in East Austin. Deeply involved in church and neighborhood activities.

observations.text: Jenny Liu owns a holistic wellness clinic called Jade Wellness on East Cesar Chavez Street in Austin.
Jenny Liu was born in Houston, Texas, and moved to Austin in 2010.
Jenny Liu earned her Master of Acupuncture degree from the Academy of Oriental Medicine at Austin in 2012.
Jenny Liu and Ruth Okonkwo attend the First United Methodist Church on East 12th Street every Sunday.
Jenny Liu and Hana Petrov are next-door neighbors on East 6th Street and share a fence.
Jenny Liu grows medicinal herbs at the community garden including lavender, chamomile, echinacea, and lemon balm.
Jenny Liu's husband, David Liu, is a structural engineer at Kimley-Horn's Austin office.
Jenny Liu has twin daughters named Lily and Rose who are in 7th grade at Kealing Middle School.
Jenny Liu completed a 200-hour yoga teacher training at Black Swan Yoga in March 2024.
Jenny Liu organized a free community acupuncture clinic at the garden pavilion in April 2024, treating 28 people.
Jenny Liu attends Ruth Okonkwo's Eastside Book Club on the first Thursday of every month.
Jenny Liu speaks English, Mandarin, and Cantonese fluently.
Jenny Liu drives a dark blue 2022 Hyundai Tucson.
Jenny Liu's favorite tea is a hand-blended chrysanthemum and goji berry mix that she sources from a farm in Fujian province.
Jenny Liu donated herbal tea blends to the Capital Area Food Bank's holiday gift basket program in December 2023.
Jenny Liu taught a workshop on growing medicinal herbs at the Austin Garden Center in May 2024.
Jenny Liu runs 3 miles around Lady Bird Lake every morning at 6:15 AM.
Jenny Liu's mother, Mei-Ling, owns a dim sum restaurant called Lucky Star in Houston's Chinatown.
Jenny Liu is training for the Austin Marathon in February 2025, her first full marathon.
Jenny Liu planted a 15-foot fig tree at the community garden entrance in October 2023 that now provides shade for the picnic area.

people.name: Hana Petrov
people.role: Graduate student in urban planning at UT Austin
people.profile: Bulgarian-American, born in Austin. Writing her thesis on community-led green spaces. The youngest gardener and the tech-savvy organizer of the group.

observations.text: Hana Petrov is a second-year master's student in Urban Planning at the University of Texas at Austin.
Hana Petrov was born in Austin, Texas; her parents emigrated from Sofia, Bulgaria, in 1995.
Hana Petrov's thesis is titled 'Community-Led Green Spaces as Catalysts for Neighborhood Resilience in East Austin.'
Hana Petrov and Sam Delgado meet every Sunday morning at Bennu Coffee on East 11th Street to plan garden activities for the week.
Hana Petrov and Jenny Liu are next-door neighbors on East 6th Street and share a fence.
Hana Petrov built the community garden's website and scheduling app using React and Firebase.
Hana Petrov's father, Dimitar, owns a small auto repair shop called Petrov's Garage on East Riverside Drive.
Hana Petrov's mother, Irina, teaches Bulgarian folk dance at the Austin Bulgarian Cultural Center.
Hana Petrov conducted a survey of 150 East Austin residents about green space access for her thesis in March 2024.
Hana Petrov grows sunflowers and zinnias in her community garden plot, selling bouquets at the SFC Farmers Market for $8 each.
Hana Petrov rides a yellow Cannondale Quick hybrid bike to campus every day.
Hana Petrov attends Ruth Okonkwo's Eastside Book Club on the first Thursday of every month.
Hana Petrov speaks English, Bulgarian, and intermediate Spanish.
Hana Petrov won a $3,500 research grant from the UT Austin School of Architecture for her thesis fieldwork.
Hana Petrov interned at the Austin City Planning Department in the summer of 2023, working on the East Riverside corridor plan.
Hana Petrov's favorite restaurant is Veracruz All Natural, where she orders the migas taco every Saturday.
Hana Petrov volunteers at Habitat for Humanity Austin on the second Saturday of every month.
Hana Petrov adopted a gray cat named Banitsa from Austin Animal Center in February 2024.
Hana Petrov presented her green space research at the American Planning Association's Texas Chapter conference in October 2024.
Hana Petrov organized a mural-painting day at the community garden in August 2024, with local artist Maria Torres creating a 12-by-8-foot mural.

chain_examples.k4_example: Ruth -> Sam (garden plot partners) -> Hana (Sunday coffee planners) -> Jenny (next-door neighbors) -> Ruth (church members). This is a 4-hop chain traversing all 4 people and returning to the start.
chain_examples.k5_note: With 4 people, the maximum unique-person chain is K=4 (visiting each person once). A K=5 chain requires revisiting one person, e.g.: Sam -> Ruth (garden partners) -> Jenny (church) -> Hana (neighbors) -> Sam (coffee planners) -> Ruth (garden partners). The cross-links (Ruth-Hana book club, Ruth-Jenny church) enable multiple distinct paths for multi-hop reasoning.
